verdict.rationale: Navan documents receipt scanning for expenses, and its own AI surfaces explain why transactions were flagged and compare spend to company policy. That is thin, partial support for the reading-receipts and auditing parts of the story. Nothing shows AI suggesting expense categories or memos, or detecting duplicates or fraud. missing for 10: AI-driven category/GL coding suggestions, AI-generated memos, duplicate detection, fraud detection, explicit AI receipt extraction details, independent or hands-on corroboration
